previous: D-075 parent section (four question cards). Mom's review, 2026-10-12: no guided person may put off busy parents who pay a learning centre so they do not have to be involved. Savar: those parents care most about convenience.
decision: How should the existing parent section answer a busy parent: what does the parent still do, and what do we take off their plate?
primary_axis: message and structure inside the one existing section (no new section)
invariants: one section, same place on the home page, eyebrow 'For parents'
only true claims: we mark from the photo (How it works step 04), the next book is planned from scans, books are mailed, scan for step-by-step help, rewards, pause
no number for parent minutes (we have no data); daily time 15-30 minutes per open PR #131

options.name: Current
options.bet: Reference: 'Your commitment as a parent.' and the D-075 cards

options.name: Same cards, new words
options.bet: Keep the 2 x 2 cards; new title 'We do the marking and planning. You hand over the book.'; cards say what we do
options.benefit: Smallest change; keeps Randy's getting-started card
options.cost: Still four blocks of text to read
options.risk: The title is long on phones

options.name: Your two jobs, said first
options.bet: Title 'Your part takes a few minutes a day.'; the two parent jobs in large type, then three short answers
options.benefit: The parent's load is clear in two seconds
options.cost: Drops the getting-started card (one line in the panel instead)
options.risk: 'A few minutes' reads as a promise; the first week takes more

options.name: Struck-out jobs list
options.bet: Title 'Less for you to do, not more.'; five jobs we take off the list, struck out, and a card with what stays
options.benefit: Shows the convenience directly; easy to scan
options.risk: The struck-out row 'Drive to a centre' reads as a jab at learning centres

options.name: Parent's question + rows
options.bet: The busy parent's own question as the title; five labelled rows (time, marking, teaching, travel, getting started)
options.benefit: Speaks to the objection in the parent's words; compact
options.cost: Drops the 'what if they don't want to' answer
options.risk: A quote as a title is a new pattern on the page

recommendation: A or C. A is the safe change; C makes the convenience point most clearly.
